nodes.title: ticket_ref round-trips absence as absence in the investigation store
nodes.summary: relational-investigation-store.repository.ts now writes an absent-or-empty ticket_ref as a real SQL NULL and reads a NULL column back as an absent attribute, never coalescing it to the empty string on either side.

nodes.title: ticket_ref round-trips absence, never the empty string
nodes.summary: Tests over relational-investigation-store.repository.ts proving that an absent or empty-string ticket_ref is written and read back as absence, and that a given non-empty ticket_ref is written and read back exactly unchanged, replacing the two pre-existing tests that had pinned the coalesce-to-empty-string bug this task fixes.

nodes.title: investigation-ticket-ref-absence-hotfix, review
nodes.summary: What four passes found over the source and tests making ticket_ref round-trip absence as absence, never as an empty string.
unproven: A diagnose call giving an empty string as its ticket reference is recorded and read back as an absent ticket_ref, never as an empty-string value, matching rules/investigation/an-empty-ticket-reference-is-no-ticket-reference.
